name: empty-values
reference: spec/engine-spec.md Version 0.13 (the tlv wire): empty items 3 (utf8) and 13 (hex) are the empty string, written as 03 00 and 0d 00; empty items 4 and 5 (uint) are absent (ruling 1 of 0.13): 5 is not written, 4 is written as its default 6 (04 02 0006). Set length stays 1b (two 2-byte empty items out, one 4-byte item in). Input values chosen for this vector; derived without an engine by a standalone program.
